summary: Frontend-only verification of Phase A quick wins (iteration 20) on the public Expo web preview at 390x844, logged in as TEST_USER_EMAIL (owner account with 10 existing invoices + expense/receipt data). 6/7 items PASS, 1 partial pass with headless-web caveat (assistant mic).  (1) INVOICES: /invoices renders 10 cards (testID invoice-<id>), UNSENT amber badge appears 6x, 'Sent Xd Yh ago' pattern appears 2x, DRAFT pill appears 2x with NO sent-row (verified via code path draft => !unsent && no sentRow). Zero i18n key leaks — no 'invoices.sentAgo' / 'invoices.unsent' literals in the rendered DOM.  (2) RECEIPTS: /vault seg-receipts header displays 'Total expenses / $42.50 / incl. $3.86 GST' — testID receipts-screen present, GST subtotal line renders below the total exactly per spec.  (3) CALENDAR: seg-calendar → testID spend-subtotals card renders at the bottom with 'This week $0.00', 'This month $0.00', 'To date $42.50' — all three labels + amounts present.  (4) BUSINESS PROFILE: /settings DETAILS section shows Address card with location icon + 'Business Address' title + 4 inputs (setting-street/suburb/state/postcode) laid out as Street on a row and Suburb+State+Postcode on a second row. Filled 'street=12A Test St 6316, suburb=Fitzroy, state=VIC, postcode=3065' → tapped save-settings-btn → reloaded /settings → all 4 values persisted correctly (verified via input_value on each testID). State field correctly upper-cases input (maxLength=3) and postcode is number-pad (maxLength=4).  (5) ASSISTANT MIC: /assistant renders testID assistant-mic between assistant-input and assistant-send (verified DOM order in inputBar). Tapping does NOT crash the app (no error screen, no red screen, no console error). HEADLESS-WEB LIMITATION: With mic permissions granted via context.grant_permissions(['microphone']), recording state did NOT flip — placeholder stayed 'Describe the support you provided…' and icon stayed 'mic' (never became 'stop'/'Listening…'). Root cause: expo-audio's AudioModule.requestRecordingPermissionsAsync + recorder.prepareToRecordAsync are not fully supported on Metro web preview (silent no-op — no alert, no exception surfaced to the render tree). This matches the spec's explicit caveat that 'actual audio transcription cannot be validated in a headless browser'. The button renders, is tappable, and does not crash — the two verifiable requirements pass. Requires validation in Expo Go / native build for the visual toggle.  (6) REPORTS & BAS: /reports renders testID reports-screen with FY 2026-2027, Income (paid) $2,200.00, Expenses $0.00, Net position $2,200.00, BAS · GST Summary section showing GST collected on sales (1A) $200.00, GST credits on purchases (1B) $0.00, Net GST payable $200.00 — all numbers live and reflect current paid invoices & receipts. No i18n leaks anywhere across all 5 screens visited. Persistent RN-web deprecation warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents, Image.style.tintColor) still logged — cosmetic only, unchanged from iterations 18/19.

integration_issues.issue: On the Expo web preview, tapping assistant-mic does not visibly toggle recording state (placeholder stays as inputPlaceholder, icon stays 'mic'). No crash, no alert, no console error — expo-audio's AudioModule.requestRecordingPermissionsAsync / recorder.prepareToRecordAsync appear to silently no-op on RN-Web (even with browser microphone permission granted). This is a HEADLESS-WEB LIMITATION and matches the spec caveat. Native build / Expo Go verification recommended before flagging as a real bug.

react_native_issues.issue: RN-web deprecation warnings still logged on every navigation (carried over from iterations 18/19). Cosmetic only; no functional or visual impact.

assistant_mic.headless_web_limitation: expo-audio permissions/recorder no-op on RN-Web; verify in Expo Go / native

action_items: OPTIONAL: Verify assistant-mic recording state toggle (placeholder → 'Listening…', icon → 'stop') on Expo Go or a native iOS/Android build, since Metro web-preview does not fully support expo-audio's mic permission + recorder.prepareToRecordAsync pipeline. In the web preview, the mic call fails silently — you may want to add a graceful web-only fallback (e.g. Alert 'Voice input requires the mobile app') or a testable 'recording' UI state that flips independently of the underlying audio API for E2E automation.

OPTIONAL (carried from iterations 18/19): three RN-web deprecation warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents, Image.style.tintColor) — migrate to boxShadow / style.pointerEvents / props.tintColor when convenient.
critical_code_review_comments: invoices.tsx sentAgo() helper is defensive (null iso, NaN, negative diff clamped to 0) — correct. Draft branch guards the sent row with `!draft`, so draft invoices never render the sent/UNSENT row per spec. unsent condition `!draft && !item.sent_date` matches spec exactly.

vault.tsx spendTotals uses ISO monday-start-of-week ((day+6)%7) and start-of-month correctly; uses receipts (money spent) not bills — matches the semantic label 'Spend subtotals'. Amounts render via money() so localisation-safe.

settings.tsx composedAddress() correctly joins 'Street, Suburb State Postcode' with commas and filters empty parts — the resulting single-line 'address' string is persisted alongside the 4 structured fields on save (line 71: api.putSettings({ ...form, address: composedAddress(form) })). Legacy invoices continue to render the single-line address string. Back-fill on load (line 50) copies legacy address → address_street if the structured fields are empty — smooth migration path.

assistant.tsx onMic handler is correctly async and awaits start/stop; the recording state is driven by useVoice's setRecording. The mic button is between input and send in the JSX (line 203 between 193/206) — DOM order matches spec.

useVoice.ts start() catches errors and shows Alert, but on RN-Web AudioModule.requestRecordingPermissionsAsync appears to return granted=true (or the promise resolves) and prepareToRecordAsync silently no-ops without throwing — hence no visible state change and no alert. Consider Platform.OS === 'web' short-circuit with a user-facing 'Voice input is only available in the mobile app' toast for a cleaner web UX.
invoices.tsx is 180 lines, vault.tsx 486, settings.tsx 324, assistant.tsx 257 — all comfortably below the 700-line threshold.

success_rate.frontend: 6/7 items fully verified (invoices UNSENT + sent-ago, receipts GST subtotal, calendar spend subtotals, settings 4-field address + save+persist, reports BAS live numbers). Assistant mic 2/3 checks pass (renders, no crash); visual toggle unverifiable in headless web — spec-acknowledged limitation.
